question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

1, 5, ?, 25, 41, 61
solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive multiples of (4) are added subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/949287dc24a4f84f05d4e2c7ab6a32335e3045df4ad10ceedf8a7ff901f8e626.png] 

Hence, **"13"** is the correct answer.
